episodes.title: The Bleedin' in Sweden
episodes.summary: Desperate to keep his buddies from watching the fight at a neighbor's house, Frank promises an epic big-screen experience. But now he has to deliver.

episodes.title: Saturday Bloody Saturday
episodes.summary: Frank's attempt to teach Kevin a lesson about respect yields unintended results. Meanwhile, Maureen makes babysitting a nightmare for Bill.

episodes.title: The Through
episodes.summary: Frank makes a powerful friend at a football game. Frank's move into management stirs up trouble with his old work pals.

episodes.title: 'F' is for Halloween
episodes.summary: Halloween is all tricks and no treats as Frank secretly torpedoes Sue's shot at a real job and a bully leaves Bill afraid to don his costume.

episodes.title: Bill Murphy's Day Off
episodes.summary: Bill's surprise attack on the neighborhood bully backfires in a big way. Frank has to swallow his pride to make good on a promise to Kevin.

episodes.title: O Holy Moly Night
episodes.summary: Christmas Eve turns chaotic as Frank's deal to avoid a strike hits a last-minute snag and Bill's first stint as an altar boy leads to trouble.

episodes.title: Heavy Sledding
episodes.summary: As Frank dwells on his lost job, Sue plans a family sledding trip to lighten the mood - - but the outing creates more headaches.

episodes.title: A Girl Named Sue
episodes.summary: Frank's old boss, Bob, calls him to offer his old job at Mohican Airlines, but not to receive original position. Meanwhile, Sue ponders a change in her life.

episodes.title: The Liar's Club
episodes.summary: After bailing out of the unemployment office, Frank turns to Rosie's friend, Smokey, for a job, but not before helping Kevin move into the basement after he ditches school. Meanwhile, Sue gets a new job as a secretary, but is mistreated by the sexist heads of her company.

episodes.title: Night Shift
episodes.summary: As Frank scrambles to prove himself at a new job, Kevin and his band plot to get their song on the radio. Sue has a Plast-a-Ware brainstorm.

episodes.title: Breaking Bill
episodes.summary: Kevin's dreams of rock stardom stir up trouble at home. A setback the day before hockey tryouts pushes Bill over the edge. Sue giver her big pitch.

episodes.title: This is Not Good
episodes.summary: Frank's job takes him back to the airport, with awkward results. Kevin prepares for his date with "haircut girl". Bill revels in his new outlaw ways.

episodes.title: Fight Night
episodes.summary: Sue meets with the queen of Plast-a-Ware and plans a romantic night out with Frank. But a call from Maureen's school triggers a family meltdown.

episodes.title: F is for Fixing It
episodes.summary: As Sue and Frank try to hash things out, Kevin is wracked with guilt over the incident at Vic's. Bill comes face to face with his old nemesis.

episodes.title: Pray Away
episodes.summary: A couples retreat leads to a moment of truth for Frank and Sue. Bill and Phillip hatch a plan to deal with Jimmy. Suprises abound at Vic's party.

episodes.title: Landing the Plane
episodes.summary: Sue gears up for her big moment at the shareholders' meeting, while Frank and friends lay a trap for Scoop. But the day takes a dramatic turn.

episodes.title: Are You Ready for the Summer?
episodes.summary: The Murphys kick off summer with a trip to the town Memorial Day parade, where bottled-up frustrations and fears about the new baby boil over.

episodes.title: Paul Lynde to Block
episodes.summary: Sue's hopes of a romantic night with Frank at the drive-in are dashed when he brings the new neighbors along. Kevin's bandmates drop a bombshell.

episodes.title: The Stinger
episodes.summary: Sue dreams up a new invention, Kevin starts summer school, Bill suffers an awkward mishap at the pool, and a promotion stokes tensions at the airport.

episodes.title: Mr. Murphy's Wild Ride
episodes.summary: As the guys start work on the baby's room, Chet takes Frank on an unforgettable outing to the Air Force base. A jealous Phillip lashes out at Bill.

episodes.title: Battle of the Sexes
episodes.summary: While Sue hosts a soul-crushing focus group for the Forkoontula, Frank tries to keep Vic from bonding with Chet, and Bill sneaks out with Bridget.

episodes.title: Punch Drunk
episodes.summary: Frank can't wait to party with his new best bud on the Fourth of July, but rising tensions between Chet and Sue set off the wrong kind of fireworks.

episodes.title: Summer Vacation
episodes.summary: The family's summer trip to a lakeside cabin takes one vexing turn after another, and Kevin relives a traumatic childhood moment.

episodes.title: It's in His Blood
episodes.summary: An unwelcome surprise sends Frank's bromance with Chet into a tailspin. Maureen and Phillip train for their big day. Bill's breakup gets messy.

episodes.title: Frank the Father
episodes.summary: After bailing Kevin out, Frank tries a new parenting tactic. Meanwhile, Maureen's shot at TV fame hits a snag, and Bill weighs a big decision.

episodes.title: Bill Murphy's Night Off
episodes.summary: As the Murphys and their neighbors scour the city, Bill bounces from one harrowing ordeal to the next. Rosie's debate turns into a rescue mission.

episodes.title: Father Confessor
episodes.summary: Frank had visit his brother in law in the past few years, but when he gets an argument with his brother and Stan has the time to stop.

episodes.title: Nothing is Impossible
episodes.summary: On back-to-school night, Frank stews over flashbacks to his fourth-grade play, while Sue fights to get Kevin into a special program for "dim lights."

episodes.title: Bring Me a Tooth
episodes.summary: Frank struggles to make good on his promises to Bill and Maureen. Vic gets a rude surprise on his first day back at the radio station.

episodes.title: The 'B' Word
episodes.summary: A lunch date sends Sue even deeper into a funk, Bill discovers a different side of his grandfather, and a desperate Vic offers to record Kevin's band.

episodes.title: Just Breathe
episodes.summary: While Frank and his dad tend to an emergency at the airport, Sue spends a maddening night at the hospital, and Bill takes a beating in the hockey rink.

episodes.title: Come to Papa
episodes.summary: Frank's pledge to be a better father and husband is tested by one calamity after the next, leading to an epic meltdown at Lamaze class.

episodes.title: R is for Rosie
episodes.summary: Eager to make his mark as an alderman, Rosie heads to City Hall — only to find out the crooked mayor has his own plans for the Twelfth Ward.

episodes.title: Murphy and Son
episodes.summary: A string of good luck lifts the mood at the Murphy house. But a family outing to the fourth-grade play unleashes a fresh wave of chaos.

episodes.title: Land Ho!
episodes.summary: While Frank and the Mohican crew head to X-ray training in Cleveland, Vic gives Kevin and the band a total makeover for Kweezetoberfest.

episodes.title: Baby, Baby, Baby
episodes.summary: As Sue sets out on a star-crossed trek to the hospital, Frank races to catch a flight home — and vows to settle things with his dad once and for all.

episodes.title: The Mahogany Fortress
episodes.summary: At a family funeral, Frank deals with bottled-up emotions, Maureen befriends an embalmer, and Bill discovers the last rites can wipe away any sin.

episodes.title: The Rustvale Massacre
episodes.summary: While Sue tries to broker a peace deal with her dad, Frank meets the new airline management, and Bill and Maureen get into mischief on a field trip.

episodes.title: Blind Alley
episodes.summary: Sue hits the bars to look for her brother. Bill spends his Saturdays in a "scared straight" program. Kevin gets clingy after learning about Alice's ex.

episodes.title: Thank You So Much
episodes.summary: On Thanksgiving, Sue stresses over her family's visit, Vic begs his neighbors for help soothing the baby, and Bob's big dream suffers a setback.

episodes.title: The Searchers
episodes.summary: When Frank ducks out of a family day to scour the city for Box 16, Sue goes to a party at Vic's house. Bill and friends enjoy the perks of police life.

episodes.title: Screw Ups
episodes.summary: Sue takes Maureen to church to cure her obsession with the occult, Frank gives Bill an overdue sex talk, and Kevin pours his heart out to Smokey.

episodes.title: A Very Merry F***ing Christmas
episodes.summary: Inspired by his dad's words, Frank throws himself into a project at work. Sue starts a new business. The mayor takes his feud with Rosie too far.

episodes.title: Bye Bye, Frankie
episodes.summary: As the town flocks to the airport for the big Christmas Eve show, Frank scrambles to keep the event on track, and Rosie plots to expose the mayor.
